messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] question on trace
parts:
Michael is going to release a case study going over these
problems in depth. They're caused by divergences in the Hamiltonian
evaluation. An example is when you explore small values for hierarchical
scale parameters when there's not much data.

The only solution here is going to be reparameterize the model.
Without doing that, you can get bias in the estimates in any
reasonably long run that might not be well diagnosed by things
like R-hat and n_eff estimates.

- Bob
